_purpose: ROI + HSV thresholds for the ball color separator (separator_vision.py).
_note: Coordinates are in the 640x480 separator-cam frame. Missing keys fall back to DEFAULT_CFG in separator_vision.py.

_fields.roi_x/roi_y/roi_w/roi_h: ROI position and size that is inspected
_fields.warm_h_lo/warm_h_hi: warm (R/O/Y) hue range to mature bin
_fields.cool_h_lo/cool_h_hi: cool (blue) hue range to immature bin
_fields.black_v_max: pixels darker than this also count as cool
_fields.warm_frac/cool_frac: min percent of ROI to classify warm/cool
_fields.white_frac: min percent of white ROI to decide 'no ball'

_unused: roi_x1, roi_y1, roi_x2, roi_y2, ghost_frames, area_min, area_max are legacy keys not read by separator_vision.py; kept for reference.
